128651: Hanako is a ghost haunting the old building of Kamome Academy. He resides on the third floor female bathroom, in the toilet of the third stall. He governs over the Seven Mysteries as School Mystery Number 7.
128652: Yashiro Nene is a normal student, and one day she listens to a rumor about ''Hanako-san'' who makes wishes for anyone, but the wishes come with a price. She visits him in the hope of getting her crush to fall in love with her.
137221: Yugi Tsukasa is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy. He currently resides at the school's broadcasting club room, with its members Sakura and Natsuhiko.
137222: Minamoto Kou is a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School Division, and a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.
137223: Nanamine Sakura is a 3rd-year student at Kamome Academy's High School division. She made a contract with Tsukasa and is now bound to him. She is a member of the school's broadcasting club.
137224: Minamoto Teru is a 2nd year student at Kamome Academy's High School Division and the school's Student Council President. He is also a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan. Teru is Kou's older brother.
141671: Mitsuba, real name Sousuke Mitsuba is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy Middle School's lockers. He was a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School division and a member of the photography club before his death.
150855: Akane Aoi is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School division as one of Nene's classmates, and the student council's vice president.
150856: Yamabuki Lemon is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School divison and Nene, Aoi and Akane's classmate.
152004: Tsuchigomori is a science teacher at Kamome Academy. He is secretly a supernatural, representing and curating the academy's 5th School Wonder, the 4PM Bookstacks. He is also Kou's current homeroom teacher.
152005: The fox statue spirit that holds the title of Number Two of The Seven Wonders (二番目の七不思議. Romaji: _Ni-ban me no Nanafushigi_) as the Misaki's Stair ghost. She took on the form of a beautiful lady inside her territory while outside, she took the form of a kitsune spirit.
152422: Akane Aoi is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School Division and Nene's friend.
152426: Shijima Mei is a former student at Kamome Academy and the current School Mystery Number 4.
156186: Natsuhiko Hyuuga is a 2nd year student at Kamome Academy's High School division. He is a member of the school's broadcasting club.
158444: The homeroom teacher of Nene's class.
159474: The namesake of the Second Wonders of The Seven Wonders, Misaki's Stair and supposed teacher of Yako. He is capable of interacting with spirits and ghosts. He died after falling from the stair of a certain shrine.
170225: Satou is a 3rd year student at Kamome Gakuen's middle school. He is Minamoto Kou's friend and is usually seen together with Yokoo.
170226: Yokoo is a 3rd year student at Kamome Gakuen's middle school. He is Minamoto Kou's friend and is usually seen together with Satou.
202520: Mermaid is a high-ranking supernatural in the Jibaku Shounen Hanako-kun series. She is able to manifest in Kamome Academy while living underwater with other fish, although it is unclear whether that place is bound to the school.
215549: Kodama is known as the Confession Tree and a supernatural that only appears in front of couples and brings all love confessed below it to fruition.
219130: Fuji Suzuto is a first-year high school student at Kamome Gakuen that is briefly shown to be in Nene's class and is also depicted to be affiliated with the student council.
